exposure: proportion of births in the National Health Service (NHS) trust planned in midwifery units or at home
presence of an alongside midwifery unit (AMU)
cohort: 'Low-risk' women with a 'term' pregnancy planning vaginal birth in a stratified, random sample of 36 OUs
finding: Trusts with greater provision of non-OU intrapartum care may have higher intervention rates in planned 'low-risk' OU births, but at a trust level this is likely to be more than offset by lower intervention rates in planned non-OU births.
